what: Cell sanitization sketch uses tr -d for tabs but acceptance and FINDING_5 require tabs become a single space
scenario_or_breakage: Embedded tab in a rating or reviewer cell is deleted instead of normalized; downstream TSV consumers see concatenated tokens (e.g. majorblocker)
suggested_fix: Use tr '\t' ' ' (or sed) before newline flattening; add a harness fixture that asserts a tab inside an axis value becomes a space not removal
